dataList.content:
After matching various pieces of information we found from the defeated Yurodiviye members together...
我们在被打倒的圣愚成员的口袋里找出了纸条。在根据其中的内容进行讨论后……
dataList.place:
An Alleyway of T Corp.
T公司小巷

dataList.content:
... we managed to track them down to a run-down building that appeared to be their hideout.
我们成功追踪到了看起来像是他们的秘密基地的破旧建筑物前。

You've finally managed to track us down, haven't you... Filthy watch chains of T Corp.! And you... you clock!
你们终于找到这里了，T公司肮脏的表链子们和……那个时钟！

It's only elementary. Because I am... an ace detective.
这是当然，我可是……名侦探。

Rodya exclaimed triumphantly as she flicked her hair back, but I sensed the smallest hint of uncertainty in her voice.
罗佳撩起头发自信地说道，但我从她的声音中觉察到一丝迟疑。

Yep, we're all ace detectives.
没错，我们是名侦探。

Tsk... I'll admit, we shouldn't have let you track us down. ... But you don't look too strong.
虽然据点被发现是惨痛的失误，但你们看起来也没有那么强。

It is a foolish move to fight a lion in his den... I hope you've prepared yourselves.
竟然在对我们有利的地方战斗……你们应该做好心理准备了吧？

Don'tcha worry about our butts. We've got a Class 5 with us, y'know!
别担心我们。我们可是有5级员工跟着，是吧？

Hm, I can deduce a few things about you. One. That man's outfit... that aloof look on his face... I see. It's likely that you're not lying that he really is a Class 5 Staff member.
那套服装、那从容的态度……可以看出两点，一是他很可能真的是5级员工，二是……

Two. You are absolutely shameless for bringing a Class 5 watch chain to a run-down hideout like this.
你们把5级表链子带到这个简陋的秘密基地，可真没良心。

Why does this have anything to do with shame...?
这跟良心有什么关系……？

I don't know about shame, but this place sure is run-down.
良心的事我不清楚，但这地方确实简陋。

Right, how about this? I'll sit this one out just for the sake of fairness.
啊，那么为了公平就这么办吧。我不插手。

It'll be like cheating if I were to take part in this fight, yeah?
要是我参加战斗的话，果然有些犯规吧。

That is... a fair proposal. Fine, I accept your offer.
这……很公平。我接受你的提议。

<Do we not get a say in any of this...?>
<为什么你们擅自决定了……？>
